_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Vayikra 26, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Do not make for yourselves idols; and a carved thing and a standing-stone do not erect for yourselves; and an ornamental stone do not make in your lands to bow down to it. I am God, your Lord, the One.
translations.2: My sabbaths — keep them; and My sanctuary — hold it in awe. I am God; I shall recompense you with good.
translations.3: Only if you walk in My statutes, and keep My commandments, and act according to them —
translations.4: I shall send down your rains in their seasons, and the earth shall bring forth its yield, and the trees of the wilderness shall bring forth their fruit;
translations.5: until the threshing shall overtake for you the harvest, and the harvest shall overtake the sowing; and you shall eat your food with pleasure, and you shall dwell secure in your land.
translations.6: And I shall establish peace for you in the land, so that you shall lie down with nothing to disturb you; and I shall cause the harm of the destructive beast to cease from the land; and no sword shall pass through your land.
translations.7: And when you hunt down your enemies, they shall fall before you under your swords.
translations.8: Until five of you shall hunt down hundreds, and a hundred of you shall hunt down a multitude; and your enemies shall fall before you under your swords.
translations.9: And I shall turn toward you, and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I shall fulfil My covenant with you.
translations.10: And you shall eat the aged, long-stored; and you shall bring out the aged to make room for the new.
translations.11: And I shall set My dwelling-place among you, and I shall not loathe you.
translations.12: And I shall cause My light to move among you, and I shall be the God for you, and you shall be for Me a special people.
translations.13: I am God your Lord, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from being slaves to them; and I broke the yoke-bars of your bonds, and led you forth as free people.
translations.14: But if you do not hearken to Me and obey, and do not act according to all these commandments —
translations.15: but rather you have turned away from My statutes, and your souls have come to loathe My ordinances so as not to act according to My commandments, and you break My covenant —
translations.16: I too shall do to you these punishments: I shall set over you in haste the fever of consumption and the burning heat, which make your eyes stare and drain away your souls; and you shall sow your seed for nothing, and your enemies shall eat it.
translations.17: And I shall bring My wrath upon you, so that you shall be struck down before your enemies; and those who hate you shall rule over you, and you shall flee with none pursuing you.
translations.18: And if you still do not accept from Me with all this, I shall increase your chastisement sevenfold upon your sins.
translations.19: And I shall break the might of your pride, and make your sky like iron and your earth like copper.
translations.20: And your strength shall perish for nothing; and your land shall not bring forth its yield, and the trees of the wilderness shall not bring forth their fruit.
translations.21: And if you have walked with Me in contention, and have not been willing to hearken to Me, I shall add upon you a blow — sevenfold upon your sins.
translations.22: And I shall release against you the beasts of the wilderness, and they shall bereave you of your children, and cut down your cattle, and reduce your number; and your roads shall become desolate.
translations.23: And if you are not disciplined toward Me by these punishments, and you walk with Me in contention —
translations.24: I too shall walk with you in contention, and I shall smite you sevenfold upon your sins.
translations.25: And I shall recompense you with a sword that avenges the vengeance of the covenant; and you shall gather into your towns, and I shall send pestilence among you, and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
translations.26: And I shall break for you the spring of food, so that many women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall return it by weight; and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
translations.27: And if you do not hearken to Me and obey, with all these punishments, and you walk with Me in contention —
translations.28: I too shall walk with you with the punishments of contention, and I shall discipline you sevenfold upon your sins.
translations.29: Until you eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.
translations.31: And I shall make your towns a ruin, and cause desolation in your sanctuaries, and I shall neither accept nor be pleased with your offerings.
translations.32: And I shall desolate the land of you, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be desolated of it.
translations.33: And I shall scatter you among the nations, and I shall draw the sword after you; and your land shall become a waste, and your towns a ruin.
translations.34: At that time the land shall receive its rest — all the days of its desolation — while you are in the land of your enemies; at that time the land shall be left fallow, and receive its rest.
translations.35: And the reason for the length of the days of its desolation is that it shall rest, even as you did not let it rest in its rest-times while you were dwelling upon it.
translations.36: And those of you who remain — I shall bring cowardice into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even if the sound of a driven leaf overtook them, they would flee as one fleeing from the sword, and they would fall with none pursuing them.
translations.37: And they shall stumble over one another, as happens before the sword, with none pursuing; and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
translations.38: And some of you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall consume you.
translations.39: And those of you who remain shall be humbled by their sins in the lands of your enemies; and also by the sins of their fathers who are with them they shall be humbled.
translations.40: But if they confess their sins and the sins of their fathers — in their treachery with which they were treacherous against Me, and in that they walked with Me in contention and did not repent —
translations.41: I too shall walk with them in contention, and I shall bring them into the lands of their enemies again; or until their obdurate heart is subdued, or until they have paid the full price of their sins.
translations.42: Then I shall remember for them My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham — I shall remember it for them and for their offspring.
translations.43: And the land that was left of them, and received its rest through being desolated of them — and they, for their part, paid the full price of their sins, as their recompense and part of their recompense — since they had turned away from My ordinances, and their souls had loathed My statutes.
translations.44: And also, along with all these things — even while they are in the lands of their enemies — I shall not turn away from them, nor shall I loathe them to destroy them, nor shall I annul My covenant with them; for I am God their Lord.
translations.45: And I shall remember for them the covenant of the first ones, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt in the presence of the nations, to be their God. I am God, true to My promise.
translations.46: These are the statutes and the ordinances and the guiding principles which God established between Him and the sons of Israel, upon Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.
